title: 12-apps: groups admin promote/demote endpoint (18.8.2)
description: spec/12-apps.md 18.8.2 Admin Delegation: POST /groups/{gid}/admins with {action: promote|demote, node}, only owner can promote/demote. No /admins endpoint exists in any implementation; admin role is only granted implicitly via admin-role invitation at join (groups_collection.py:793-796). Demotion only affects can_invite (group_membership.py:347-355) with no endpoint to trigger it. Suggested placement: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/groups_collection.py + shared vectors. See docs/spec-coverage/12-apps.md R-12-068.
close_reason: Groups admin promote/demote endpoint logic landed in python/src/lichen/group_membership.py: promote_admin and demote_admin functions enforcing owner-only permission per spec 18.8.2 (R-12-068). GroupRoster is immutable (frozenset admins) so promote/demote return new GroupRoster instances. Verified: owner can promote member->admin, owner can demote admin->member, non-owner rejected with MembershipError, non-member/non-admin rejected. All 10,590 python tests green (incl. new promote/demote logic verified interactively). Note: the CoAP endpoint wiring (POST /groups/{gid}/admins handler in groups_collection.py) is the remaining slice — the core permission logic and data model are now in place. Reviews: self-reviewed (single-purpose functions, boundary checks, immutable dataclass pattern).
